- requirement: "Add a new default-on soft-deadline budget knob (for example REVIEW_SOFT_DEADLINE_MINUTES) with a safe default below the job timeout-minutes backstop."

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Implemented — `REVIEW_SOFT_DEADLINE_MINUTES: ${{ vars.REVIEW_SOFT_DEADLINE_MINUTES || '210' }}` is added, with 210 minutes below the 240-minute job timeout, plus job-level wiring in `runtime_context`.
- requirement: "Expose remaining/elapsed budget in the existing CODEX_HEARTBEAT output without renaming the heartbeat prefix or existing fields. Add new fields additively."
  expected_change_site: scripts/codex_heartbeat.sh and scripts/codex_stall_guard.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Implemented — both scripts append `budget_elapsed_secs` and `budget_remaining_secs` additively without changing the existing `CODEX_HEARTBEAT` prefix or existing fields.
- requirement: "Wire shared budget-accounting helpers into the workflow and the reviewer/editor entrypoints so every major phase can ask whether it is still allowed to start."
  expected_change_site: scripts/watchdog_helpers.sh, scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh, scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Implemented — `watchdog_helpers.sh` provides the `codex_run_budget_*` helpers; `review_run_reviewers.sh` calls `codex_run_budget_export` and `emit_run_budget_gate_note`; `review_apply_fixes.sh` uses `codex_run_budget_remaining_secs`.
- requirement: "Land only the primitive and wiring in this phase; later phases will consume it to finalize, resume, retry, and enforce partial-push safety. Do not introduce a new red/failing terminal path when the soft deadline is reached."
  expected_change_site: All modified files
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Implemented — no terminal failure path is introduced; the budget remains advisory/fail-open.
- requirement: "README documents the new knob and default under the existing review/autofix documentation without broad reflow."
  expected_change_site: README.md
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: Implemented — additive documentation entries were added in the existing review/autofix tables.
